about: Known wrong-target control confusions for corpus/replay-measure.ps1 -Project zstd (design 7.3): a hook's cases that also pass on another function of the new build which nothing in the call graph links to it, examined and accepted as a limit of replay. The gate fails on any confusion not listed here, and on a listed one that no longer happens. Applies to the run with these flags and new release only.
